checks: Actual process_event dispatch reports one error dialog and returns a valid full redraw result
Entire file context stays byte-identical after failure, including the desired column normally reset by nonvertical events
Old target text and links remain readable and index rollback remains owned after partial writes
Successful left crossing selects the previous line end; right crossing selects the next line start with zero horizontal scroll
Plain movement clears selection on success; shifted movement creates or retains the correct anchor
Successful horizontal movement clears the desired column for later vertical movement
Inline movement in alternative stores issues no payload writes and retains the dirty editor buffer
The vertical keyboard and prior commit/command fault cases remain included in the expanded probe
constraints: Destination text is staged before committing the source line; the checks cover read/commit refusal before movement publication.
The BIOS hook acknowledges the error dialog. Optional cache allocation is refused during disk-store fixture setup.
The default DOS store retains its existing undo final-commit behavior, including after inline movement.
Subsequent viewport normalization and screen rendering still use unchecked storage access.
Legacy movement helpers remain for page, word, mouse, search and editing callers.

remaining: Checked commit migration for remaining navigation, editing and legacy callers

Safe old/orphaned payload reclamation and checked free-list mutation
